verdict.rationale: Granola's documented pre-meeting briefs are prepared overnight; when you open the note as you join, you see a short brief with open threads, relevant context and agenda points so you walk in ready. This rests on its calendar connection, which surfaces upcoming meetings and meeting context. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that it surfaces past meetings with the same attendees (only implied by 'relevant context'), and independent or hands-on corroboration of brief quality.
